title: Evaluation of dioxin-like polychlorinated biphenyls in fish of the Caspian Sea
author: Ebadi Fathabad, Tajik, et al.

steps.title: Collect fish samples
steps.instruction: Randomly collect 125 fish (25 per city) from five stations (Bandar Anzali, Rasht, Chalous, Bandar Torkaman, Astara), place each fish in a cold box with ice, then transport to the laboratory.

steps.title: Store and dissect samples
steps.instruction: Record biometric data, separate ~50 g of muscle tissue from each fish, wrap tissue in aluminum foil, and store at –20 °C in the dark until analysis.

steps.title: Homogenize tissue with sodium sulfate
steps.instruction: Place the 50 g muscle tissue in a crusher (Moulinex) and crush three times; add 100 g Na₂SO₄, then homogenize the mixture at 50 °C for 6 h.

steps.title: Add internal standard
steps.instruction: Spike each homogenized sample with 50 ng of PCB 209 internal standard.

steps.title: Soxhlet lipid extraction
steps.instruction: Perform Soxhlet extraction on the spiked sample using a hexane/acetone solvent mixture (90:10 v/v); repeat the extraction approximately 260 times.

steps.title: Determine lipid gravimetrically
steps.instruction: Collect the extracted lipids and weigh them to determine lipid mass.

steps.title: Prepare lipid solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 1 g of the extracted lipid in 10 mL n‑hexane (HPLC grade) to obtain a diluted extract for purification.

steps.title: Activate silica gel column
steps.instruction: Prepare multi‑layer silica gel columns and activate the silica according to the referenced method.

steps.title: Purify extract on silica column
steps.instruction: Pass the diluted lipid extract through the activated silica column, collect the eluate, then elute DL‑PCBs with 50 mL n‑hexane (HPLC grade).

steps.title: Concentrate eluate
steps.instruction: Concentrate the 50 mL eluate using a rotary evaporator at 40 °C until the final volume reaches 1 mL.

steps.title: Inject into HRGC/HRMS
steps.instruction: Inject the 1 mL concentrated extract into the high‑resolution gas chromatography/high‑resolution mass spectrometry (HRGC/HRMS) system for analysis.

steps.title: Prepare calibration standards
steps.instruction: Prepare calibration standards covering 1–10 points ranging from 1 to 1000 µg L⁻¹; verify linearity (R² > 0.99) before sample analysis.

steps.title: Validate method performance
steps.instruction: Confirm mean recoveries of 98–110 % for the 12 DL‑PCB congeners and limits of quantification of 0.03–0.09 pg g⁻¹ fat.
